description: The floor from cost (CAT-06, PRD Q2, D-092, W1-14): the item's average cost × (10,000 + the category's floor_min_margin_bp) / 10,000, half away from zero to the minor unit (D-079). No cost, or a category without a margin, gives no cost floor, and then the list price stays the floor. An explicit floor_price wins over it on the counter.

cases.name: more than half a paisa rounds up: Rs 33.33 at 5% = 3,499.65 paisa → Rs 35.00
below half a paisa rounds down: Rs 0.09 at 5% = 9.45 paisa → 9
exactly half a paisa rounds away from zero: 10 paisa at 5% = 10.5 → 11
a margin of 0: the floor is the cost
a cost of 0 gives a floor of 0
no cost known: no cost floor
a category without a margin: no cost floor
